_doc.what: Every spell priced in M (one measure, ITEM_POWER.md) at L50 on the scale Kit approved 2026-10-28. Use it for magic item spell picks (pills, potions, scrolls, wands, staves), granted skills and any spell price question.
_doc.worn: permanent affect on a worn item; null when it has no affect meaning (nukes, heals, pets, item-making rituals)
_doc.charge: one use: one pill/potion/scroll or one wand/staff charge; charges price linearly (x10 wand = 10 x charge)
_doc.grant: item-granted skill (grantskills, learned 100), char-less base the gear sage would give
_doc.src: per price: 'kit' = Kit set it, 'rescaled' = model mapped monotonically onto Kit's scale (scripts/spell-value/gen/sv_rescale.py)
_doc.model: the raw model numbers before Kit (worn/charge/grant), for reference only
_doc.excluded: Kit's per-spell exclusion from magic items (R2 and the high-signature rule are dropped)
_doc.pvp: Kit weighs PK too: spell resistance and similar are priced for PvP, not only PvE
_doc.edit: Kit edits values in the artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/FNB18r6xaUD5editrNkFrY; sync with scripts/spell-value/spell-value.py --merge
